subject.title: feat: Control UI debug mode — ephemeral connection logs and error details

question: What pre-auth connection diagnostics may the Control UI expose and make copyable without weakening the auth, device, and privacy boundary?
rationale: The feature intentionally surfaces auth-adjacent handshake, device, origin, close, and error details before a trusted session exists, so automation should not choose the disclosure and redaction policy.

options.title: Sanitized client-only diagnostics
options.body: Expose only sanitized client-side connection timing phases, close codes, redacted error details, and copy support before auth, while leaving `logs.tail` post-auth only.

options.title: Authenticated-only full diagnostics
options.body: Keep pre-auth UI limited to categorized failure guidance and expose richer gateway logs only after authentication with `operator.read`.

options.title: Support export workflow
options.body: Design an explicit support export action that combines redacted client diagnostics with authenticated gateway log tails under user consent.

recommendation.title: Sanitized client-only diagnostics
recommendation.body: Expose only sanitized client-side connection timing phases, close codes, redacted error details, and copy support before auth, while leaving `logs.tail` post-auth only.

likelyOwner.reason: The disconnected login gate and auth-adjacent recovery UI are the central placement and disclosure boundary for this decision.
